note: Absolute gates are program §4.12; regression tolerances are the gate policy in docs/ask-reel-eval.md. Pre-registered 2026-10-24 before the 99c0761 baseline ran; every change made after any baseline data existed is listed in `amendments` with its reason. Change them only by a reviewed commit, never to make a run pass.

gates.label: Standing-exclusion leaks (shown titles outside the eligibility truth)
Picks against the request's own media filter
Trakt calls from the eval stack

amendments.change: fallback: a WhySource counts only when it is a typed fallback (Fallback, Stub), not any non-model source
amendments.reason: v1 stores WhySource=Generic on the captionless filmography list by design, and Templater on outside-request cards whose caption is the deterministic statement of the exclusion they trip (all 36 Templater cards in the 99c0761 open recording are outsideRequest=true). Neither is a failed model call. Effect on the open baseline: fallback rate 0.677 → 0.623.

amendments.change: (1) wrong-media picks moved out of exclusionLeaks into mediaMismatches; (2) a reply names a title only with the title's own capitalisation and not made of common words alone
amendments.reason: (1) a wrong-media pick answers the user's words, not a standing exclusion — conflating them made the leak count mostly media (leaks 160 → 66); (2) prose such as 'the other one' matched the films The Other / In and Out (grounding 120 → 118).

amendments.change: (a) Templater counts as a fallback on an in-request pick; (b) honest-empty requires a turn that ran and reported NoneFound; (c) unrun turns are scored as failed turns with failed checks, and a failed turn scores precision 0; (d) act is no data for an engine that emits none (v1) instead of being inferred from turn position; (e) failed and unrun turns are charged the client cap in latency; (f) latency gates also require every build slot held for the run; (g) mediaFilterViolations (picks against the request's own media filter) is gated; (h) compare refuses runs with different scenario fingerprints, turn counts, snapshot or artifact, compares counts paired over turns that ran in both runs, charges newly failed turns, and treats a metric the baseline measured but the run did not as a regression; (i) hedging covers the 'though … less / rather than' family and non-Latin script in English copy is counted
amendments.reason: Independent reviewers showed compare passing a run with scenarios removed (leaks 66 → 0), a 500 passing honest-empty, crashes raising act and lowering grounding/echo, timeouts improving p95, and v1's act 0.864 being a property of turn position. Each change makes failing worse, never better; none of them was chosen to move a baseline number.
